title: DM-ARCH layered DM refactor — generic delivery spine + L4 release policy
fixture: .squidsquad/dm/CLAUDE.md (composed DM, full main-landing state: dm/skill alias + L4 release policy)
method: Fresh sonnet agent given ONLY the composed DM CLAUDE.md, no prior context. Answers must come from the file alone.

questions.prompt: When do you bump the version?
questions.expected: Only because THIS project's L4 policy says so (batch-of-10 ships → minor semver bump). A generic DM with no L4 version policy has no version concept and never bumps — it ships each verified item as it's ready (ship-on-ready). Versioning is an optional L4 facet, not a universal DM duty.
questions.fail_if: Answers 'every 10 features/ships' as a universal/inherent DM rule without attributing it to the project's L4 policy, OR says the DM always bumps versions.

questions.prompt: Who owns the 'Shipped Since Last Bump' release counter — you (the DM) or the verifier? Who increments it and when?
questions.expected: The DM owns it entirely (L4-owned release state). The DM increments it by 1 at step:cycle/publish after every ship. The verifier no longer touches it.
questions.fail_if: Says the verifier increments it, or that the verifier owns/shares the counter.

questions.prompt: In your delivery spine, what does the 'package' step mean concretely for this project (skill/code domain)?
questions.expected: Merge the feature branch into main + run compose.py deploy for affected roles (merge-to-main + compose). Plus completing the product with user-facing docs.
questions.fail_if: Cannot identify merge-to-main + compose as the concrete package mechanic, or treats package as version-bumping.

questions.prompt: What is step:cycle/contribute-knowledge and what are you supposed to do there?
questions.expected: Contribute knowledge gained to the vault at two granularities: the part-level detail of your own delivery slice, AND the broad task/job-level knowledge that only the DM's end-to-end vantage can see. Fires at task completion.
questions.fail_if: Cannot describe the vault knowledge-capture at two granularities, or omits the broad end-to-end job-level capture.
